contracts.domain_retry: Expected-current-identity, failed decision-owned dispatch only; increments domain attempt within the configured budget; required successor is atomic with owner reset.
contracts.redrive: Separate permission; increments generation without resetting the monotone domain counter or replenishing its budget. Provider sent requires explicit redrive. Completed work and source-managed screening cannot be reset.
contracts.cancellation: User approved permanent decision-owned exact-attempt dispatch cancellation. Active transport and cancellation record commit together; business results are preserved; external actions cannot be undone. Same-identity/same-reason replay preserves the original timestamp. Cancelled pending work requires explicit redrive.
contracts.maintenance: Actual shared scheduler composes bounded SQL recovery and transport-only retention. Real local dispatch-exhaustion mutation fails closed for sent/completed or source-managed work. Receipts and owner rows remain permanent.
contracts.locking: One resource, latest permanent receipt, exact transport. No network work under database locks; no automatic retries of uncertain commits. Final stale-worker predicates remain required.
